parameters.name: EventInfos
parameters.description: A list of objects, where each object specifies an Event and the associated Resource to reboot.

sub_parameters.name: EventId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the System Event.

sub_parameters.name: OpsType
sub_parameters.description:
The type of Operation. Valid values:

- `immediate`: Executes the operation immediately.

- `scheduled`: Executes the Operation at the time specified by `PlanTime`.

sub_parameters.name: PlanTime
sub_parameters.description: The scheduled execution time, specified as a Timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is required when `OpsType` is `scheduled`.

sub_parameters.name: ResourceId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the Resource to be rebooted.
